implemented: Session-owned reads/actions and beforeSend guards prevent old account dialogs or late responses from acting on the next account.
Closing dialogs never calls sign-out. Explicit revoke/sign-out actions remain separate; device IDs are in a disclosure.
Public permission labels are provided by the shared catalog; technical keys remain inside account detail.
No-MFA confirmation requests only the current password; MFA policy and request payload unchanged.
account.tested: Actual component/submit handlers with fake transport, current-session sign-out positive control, stale read/revoke/MFA guards and secret input clearing.

implemented: Dirty preferences stay with the same company/account in memory; leaving/reload/discard has a clear guard. Passwords and verification codes are never retained.
Unconfirmed saves lock edits and retry the same body/op_id. Old handlers cannot submit with a new account.
Saved opt-in status is separated from mail service availability; accepted-by-server wording does not claim delivered.
Portuguese labels, help, categories, quiet hours and verification/delivery messages completed; saved/error states and44px controls clarified.
account.tested: Fake503/retry, account switch during POST, isolated draft restoration, no stale verify-confirm, full fake verification flow, PT/EN and delivery states.

implemented: Another person’s profile uses a descriptive badge heading and does not invite editing. Own profile explains how to select an unlocked badge.
Existing actual server points, thresholds and original badge assets retained.
account.tested: Own/other profile markup, edit/history/private total presence only in own profile, actual60% fixture progress, no route loss in section links.

implemented: The existing80-entry API limit is disclosed; private history is explicitly separated from team updates.
Late errors/responses cannot populate a different account’s profile.
account.tested: Actual profile/ledger handler response gating; native-navigation profile regressions remain green.
